reports.title: Celanese Corporation Reports Third Quarter Earnings;

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: "Looking to the fourth quarter, we expect year-end seasonal moderation across both businesses. We will continue to drive our strategic initiatives, our targeted growth areas, as well as our cost reduction and productivity programs," continued Richardson. "Based on these dynamics, we anticipate full-year 2026 adjusted earnings per share of approximately $6.00 to $6.25. In addition, based on our strong execution year to date, we have increased our free cash flow outlook to a range of $750 to $800 million."

"While conditions remain dynamic, the progress we are seeing across our productivity initiatives, strategic growth platforms, and cash generation efforts give us confidence in our ability to continue improving the earnings power of the company over time. We also expect to exit the year with net debt-to-operating EBITDA of approximately 4.7x, reflecting the progress we have made on deleveraging through disciplined cash generation, targeted divestitures, and focused capital allocation. We remain focused on continuing to strengthen the balance sheet, improving the quality and durability of earnings, and creating long-term shareholder value through disciplined execution of our growth and strategic initiatives," Richardson concluded.

The Company's prepared remarks related to the third quarter will be posted on its website at investors.celanese.com under Financial Information/Financial Document Library on November 2, 2026. Information about Non-US GAAP measures is included in a Non-US GAAP Financial Measures and Supplemental Information document posted on our investor relations website under Financial Information/Non-GAAP Financial Measures. Celanese Corporation is a global leader in chemistry, producing specialty material solutions used across most major industries and consumer applications. Our businesses use our chemistry, technology and commercial expertise to create value for our customers, employees and shareholders. We support sustainability by responsibly managing the materials we create and growing our portfolio of sustainable products to meet customer and societal demand. We strive to make a positive impact in our communities and to foster inclusivity across our teams. Celanese Corporation is a Fortune 500 company that employs more than 11,000 employees worldwide with 2025 net sales of $9.5 billion.
